description:
Full Planning Application
Demolition of existing buildings (part of the stable block, the Town Hall Annexe, nos. 2-12 New Broadway, existing Parish Hall and boundary wall to west and south of the church forecourt/carpark), and construction of 7 new buildings (ranging from 2 storeys to 15 storeys) with retention of former firestation and part stable block, to provide maximum of 698 residentials units, 9040sqm retail (Use Class A1/A3, 139sqm office (Use Class B1), 920sqm Health Spa (Use Class D2), and 325sqm community use (Use Class D1), with basement car parking, associated public realm and landscaping, and vehicular access off Longfield Avenue and pedestrian accesses from Longfield Avenue, Springbridge Road and New Broadway.

Conservation Area Consent
Demolition of part of stable block on northern boundary, Town Hall Annexe Office Block, prefabricated office buildings to rear of Town Hall, Nos 2-12 (even) New Broadway, existing Parish Hall and boundary wall to west and south of the Church forecourt/car park.

Listed Building Consent
Demolition of existing boundary wall to west and south side of the Church forecourt/car park to facilitate creation of 'Town Square' and new boundary treatment to church.
